subject: Co-sell enablement / technical shadow for Catalyst Consulting integration
messages:
From: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha@catalyst.consult>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Nguyen <emma.nguyen@catalyst.consult>
Date: Tue, 9 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Catalyst x Redwood — co-sell enablement + technical shadow request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the call last week — Catalyst is excited about the joint opportunities we outlined. Two asks to get us moving on enablement and early co-sell:

1) A 90-minute technical shadow session for our senior engineers to walk through Redwood Dedicated deployment patterns and the runtime integration points we commonly surface in POCs.
2) A short co-sell / sales enablement brief we can use with our AE team (one-pager + 10-slide deck).

We have a pilot opportunity with a large retail client that would benefit from a matched architecture doc and a short joint pitch deck. Can your team do the technical shadow next week (any day except Monday) and share the materials beforehand?

Attached is a draft SOW Catalyst would like to iterate on so we can commit to a pilot.

Thanks — Ayesha

Attachments: Catalyst_Onboard_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 312KB)

--
Ayesha Rahman
Partnerships Lead, Catalyst Consulting
ayesha@catalyst.consult | +1 415-555-0192

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha@catalyst.consult>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jul 2029 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Catalyst x Redwood — co-sell enablement + technical shadow request

Hi Ayesha — great to hear and thanks for the SOW.

We can absolutely run the technical shadow and build a short co-sell one-pager + deck. Proposed plan:

- Technical shadow (90 min): Thurs 11 Jul or Fri 12 Jul, 9:30–11:00 PT. Focus: Dedicated deployment topology, common KV/prefix caching patterns, and integration checklist for SI tooling.
- Sales enablement: we will produce a one-pager + 10-slide deck draft by EOW for your AE review.
- Deliverables: joint pitch deck (editable), technical integration checklist, and a 1-page SOW summary that aligns to your draft.

I've attached a short agenda for the shadow session. Can you confirm attendee list and preferred date? If Friday works better for you, we can do 10:00–11:30.

Best,

—
Soojin Lee
Director, Partner Solutions — Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0148

Attachments: technical-shadow-agenda.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 14KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ayesha Rahman <ayesha@catalyst.consult>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Catalyst x Redwood — co-sell enablement + technical shadow request

Ayesha — thanks for kicking this off. Quick commercial note: if Catalyst plans to run a pilot for the retail client and asks Redwood for credits or a price break for the POC, please flag that early. I can route a pilot credit request to Sales Ops but will need anticipated spend and timeline.

Operational asks:
- Please confirm whether Catalyst prefers an on-prem walkthrough (we can show VPC/private deployment patterns) or a hosted/Dedicated walkthrough.
- Ben — can you prepare the runtime checklist (compatibility, quantization notes, and typical latency SLOs) for the session?
- Marcus — could you add an internal slide about referral/comp install fees (high level) so Catalyst understands the GTM motion?

We should aim to have the one-pager live before the shadow so Catalyst AEs can join informed.

Vanessa
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ayesha Rahman <ayesha@catalyst.consult>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Catalyst x Redwood — co-sell enablement + technical shadow request

Thanks team — happy to run the technical content. Short notes I'll cover in the 90-min shadow:

- Quick runtime primer (10m): serving runtime overview and when to choose Dedicated vs Private.
- Integration checklist (20m): authentication/KMS patterns, network egress, KV cache/redis options, and prefix caching.
- Deployment patterns (25m): scale testing, autoscaling policies, and fallbacks.
- Live demo (25m): small sample inference job (open-model) + trace of latency/cost metrics.
- Q&A / next steps (10m).

I uploaded a working checklist to Drive that I'll reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_CatalystEnablement (internal view). Marcus — I'll defer the commercial slide to you — tagging you to add the GTM bullets.

Ben
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

--

Thanks everyone — Friday 12 Jul at 10:00–11:30 PT works for our engineers (we'll do remote). Confirmed attendee list:
- Ayesha Rahman (Partnerships)
- Emma Nguyen (Eng Lead)
- Michael Patel (Solution Architect) <michael.patel@catalyst.consult>

Requests before the session:
1) Shared slide deck (editable) + one-pager by EOD Thu so our AEs can skim ahead.
2) A short demo script or runbook that our engineers can use to reproduce the live demo after the session.

We are also attaching a lightly redlined SOW. If Redwood could review and suggest edits prior to the shadow, that would speed contracting once the POC is greenlit.

Looking forward to Friday — please send the Teams invite and the materials.

Best,
Ayesha
